notes.title: New update june/18
notes.content:
Level_1
- Sandstorm at the edge of the map reshaped and remodeled 
- Added new visual effects
- Aurora borealis visible only at night
- Fixed collision problem with TItan enemy
- Added new environmental sounds
- Increased the lighting distance of the flashlight
- Added new materials
- Improved performance
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/07645ef97907fadf8bc897d3323e97777d63f68e.jpg

Level_2
- Added new visual effects
- Remodeled and improved initial trap hatches
- Increased the lighting distance of the flashlight
- Added new materials
- Improved performance
- Fixed problem of some materials not correctly rendered
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29656976/3bede2b0f2c6c2aae35758621a9af703f055fed9.jpg

On some configurations the joypad is not detected, this problem will be resolved in the next update, we will also added level 3 with a new gameplay "escape with jeep", I'm also working on revisiting the main menu and the history of the game.
Thank you all for your support and advices
